						<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="s1"><b>FUSEBOX IS BACK</b></span></h2>
<p class="p2" style="text-align: center;">After more than a year of closure following the devastating floods of 2025, we are delighted to announce that <strong>FUSEBOX is reopening.</strong></p>
<p class="p2" style="text-align: center;">Over the past year, we’ve worked closely with our venue partners to recover, rebuild and prepare the space for its next chapter. This milestone would not have been possible without the support of our artists, hirers, audiences, partners and wider community. Thank you to everyone who has stood with us throughout this journey.</p>
<p class="p2" style="text-align: center;">We will <strong>officially reopen as part of FUSE International 2026</strong>, welcoming audiences back into the venue for a vibrant programme of performances and events. We’re also proud to host Kingston’s first Pride celebrations in partnership with Unapologetic, marking an exciting new beginning for the space.</p>
<p class="p2" style="text-align: center;"><strong>FUSEBOX has always been a place for creativity, connection and community, and we can’t wait to welcome you back through our doors.</strong></p>
<p class="p2" style="text-align: center;">Explore our upcoming events and join us as we begin this new chapter.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">———</p>
<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span class="s1"><b>ABOUT FUSEBOX</b></span></h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">FUSEBOX is a place for young people, emerging artists, key academic partners, and community organisations locally, nationally and internationally to come together. With innovation, diversity and inclusion at its heart, it is a multi-functional space, with areas for performance, exhibitions, creative practice, socialising, co-creation and more.</p>

links.text: Exhibitions & Events 5.8.2026 - 28.8.2026 FUSEBOX What Makes Us Exhibition This large-scale Open Call Exhibition features 70+ artists across three themes: Magyck, Matter, and Queer. The exhibition will unfold across three zones within FUSEBOX, reflecting its spirit as a space that matters, is magical, and is proudly queer-safe. Our aim: to reopen and reconnect FUSEBOX with the local community. Hosted by Creative Youth

Music  5.10.2026 - 26.10.2026 FUSEBOX Kingston The FUSEBOX Sessions This October, FUSEBOX is turning Mondays into the night out you didn't know you needed. This October, FUSEBOX is turning Mondays into the night out you didn't know you needed. Four weeks. Four intimate sets from artists who've already made their mark - paired with the emerging talent about to make theirs. Come for the name you know. Stay for the one you'll be telling everyone about next month. Hosted by Creative Youth

Fringe  16.10.2026 FUSEBOX Kingston Mrs Smith 1,2,3 Eyes on Me Mrs Smith was an ordinary teacher in an ordinary school until she went viral on Facebook and accidentally became a stand up comedian... Hosted by Mrs Smith

Fringe  25.11.2026 FUSEBOX Kingston Anthem for Dissatisfaction The Credit Crunch, 2007. ‘Irish Twins’ Sarah and Jamie are growing up in Belfast with a shared obsession of music and the weight of parents on the breadline. Pop, rock and punk rails against austerity Britain and an ever-failing Tory-government, giving these siblings an epic score to navigate lives that are destined for different paths. Hosted by SkelpieLimmer Productions and Brassneck Theatre Company

Children & Families  5.12.2026 FUSEBOX Kingston The Christmas Troll Set against a backdrop of local history, humour and music, The Christmas Troll is a warm, magical storytelling show about loneliness, generosity and the small acts that can change everything - especially at Christmas. Hosted by Story Storks
